snippet.title: Sega Saturn - Mahjong Gokuu Tenjiku (1994)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Mahjong Gokuu Tenjiku is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Chat Noir and published by Electronic Arts Victor, which was released in Japan in 1994.
